gaps.sentence: I can't afford a holiday this year; ___, I can't get the time off work.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides' adds a further, often decisive, reason in informal style.

gaps.sentence: He neither apologised ___ offered an explanation.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither' pairs with 'nor' in this correlative structure.

gaps.sentence: Demand for the vaccine soared; ___, production was doubled.
gaps.explanation: Soaring demand led to increased production: consequently marks the result.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we arrived ___ the storm broke.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly... when' is the fixed pair for one event interrupting another.

gaps.sentence: ___ keep the audience engaged, the lecturer used live demonstrations.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'In order to + infinitive' states the purpose of the action.

gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ you fill the tank afterwards.
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' = only if, setting a requirement for permission.

gaps.sentence: My sister is terribly reserved, ___ I'll talk to complete strangers.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' contrasts two parallel facts: her nature versus mine.
